title: Unethical Billing Practices - AVOID THIS APP!
body: This app engages in highly questionable billing practices. Charges were made to my credit card without any notification, and there is no option to manage billing details or remove payment information. I had to escalate the matter to my bank and replace my card to prevent further unauthorised charges. This lack of transparency and user control is unacceptable. I strongly advise apple to investigate and users to stay away.

title: BECAREFUL
body:
At first, the subscription appears to cost only USD 8.92 for four weeks. However, after this, an advertisement for one of their products automatically plays. You are unable to close or stop the video—only able to scroll. Once the ad ends, the window still cannot be closed. Any attempt to click on the screen results in an automatic charge of USD 57. 

Wrote in to ask for cancellation, but no responses since then.
author: Laulaulao

title: Beware!!

author: Jeffrey Lim 960123

title: Unethical Auto Renewal Subcription
body: BE VERY CAREFUL when signing up for this app. Strongly unrecommended. This app is designed with unethical deceitful intention for yearly auto renewal subscription. No proper information was given about auto renewal in the welcome email after signed up. No advance notice was given prior to expiry and auto renewal. No proper guidelines was provided for cancellation of auto renewal. Cancellation cannot be done via app nor Apple Store but can only be done manually by sending email to app developer. I hope no one fall victim after my bad experience.
author: VeNoumV
